title: Silas and the Bridge
author: Kestrel Amberdale
blurb: Kestrel Villalobos, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
